answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fakes. Each of 1,000 slots needs a 600 POA deposit, 2x 30-day earnings, burned if idle or fraudulent. An opal is cut slowly, at real cost. A farm wanting 100 slots pays 60,000 POA, lost on detection; an honest agent pays once and earns it back. Karst hides fakes in porous rock, so audits probe 5% of slots per epoch. Slots cannot be resold; a transfer burns it. The summit of 20 honest epochs returns it.
